summary: Full backend + frontend testing of SignalDeck WiFi Analysis app. 13/13 backend pytest tests pass including LLM Claude Sonnet 4.5 integration for recommendations and prediction. All 7 frontend pages render correctly with proper data, working interactions, AI-generated content, and mobile nav.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file ~657 lines; consider splitting routers (network, diagnose, ai) into modules if it grows further.
_DIAG_SESSIONS is in-memory dict - sessions lost on backend restart and not horizontally scalable. Acceptable for demo but flag for production.
_state global dict mutated by toggle_band/restart_router is process-local - same scaling caveat.
random.seed(42) inside get_devices then random.seed() reseeds globally; mostly fine but slightly affects other random consumers in the same request lifecycle.
GET /api/network/timeline returns a bare List[TimelineEvent] (not wrapped object). Consistent with frontend usage but slightly inconsistent with other endpoints' response envelopes.
POST /api/network/recommendations uses POST but takes no body - a GET would be more idiomatic for retrieval semantics.
Frontend Diagnose page polls every 800ms: confirmed reaches 100% in ~5-9s; no leaks observed.
seed_data_creation: Backend automatically seeds 6 timeline events on first /api/network/timeline call. Verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_wifi_api.py covers all 12 endpoints (status, issues, devices, heatmap, timeline, diagnose start+poll+404, band toggle valid/invalid, restart-router, recommendations, prediction). LLM calls work and respond in 3-5s. All UI pages render with data-testids: dashboard-page, fix-my-wifi-btn, run-diagnostic-btn, metric-{download,upload,latency,signal,devices,congestion}, issues-list, devices-page, devices-list, device-dev-N, heatmap-page, heatmap-canvas, router-marker, zone-zone-N, nav-{dashboard,diagnose,recommendations,heatmap,devices,timeline,prediction}[-mobile]. Mobile bottom nav works at 390x844. No console errors. Dark Swiss Brutalist theme renders cleanly with good contrast.
